tools.name: check_domain_setup
tools.description: Check whether a domain is set up to send and receive email. Returns its MX records and the mail provider they point at, its SPF record, its DMARC policy, a score out of 100 with a letter grade, the individual findings behind that score, and the next technical step. Reads public DNS only: no mail is

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_domain_setup · Private data: check_domain_setup · Public sink: check_domain_setup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_domain_setup · Private data: check_domain_setup · Public sink: check_domain_setup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_domain_setup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
